Features of Cat Translator – Human to Pet

Real-time Sound Detection

Uses the device microphone to detect meows and other cat vocalizations, analyzing characteristics such as pitch, duration, and intensity to provide immediate feedback during interactions.

Human-readable Translation

Presents possible interpretations of detected cat sounds in simple, human-readable phrases. Multiple interpretation options and confidence indicators can help communicate uncertainty when vocalizations have different possible meanings.

Personalized Learning and History

Helps users review recorded sounds, save corrections, and track interactions over time. Where supported, playback, event timelines, and exportable logs make it easier to monitor patterns in a cat’s vocal behavior and observe changes.
